create.name: Dr. Amit Goswami
create.bio:
Dr. Amit Goswami is a theoretical physicist who taught at the University of Oregon from 1968 until his retirement in 1997 and has since spent decades arguing that reality rests on consciousness rather than on matter. Wrestling with the puzzles of quantum measurement, he found that they became clearer when read through the qualified non-dualism of Indian Vedanta, and he has built on that meeting of physics and spirituality ever since, with ideas about creativity, evolution, reincarnation and economics.

He set out the case in The Self-Aware Universe and went on to write many further books, among them Physics of the Soul, Quantum Creativity, God Is Not Dead, The Everything Answer Book and Quantum Spirituality, the last with the physician Valentina Onisor. He appeared in the film What the Bleep Do We Know!? and is the subject of the documentary The Quantum Activist. In 2009 he began what he calls quantum activism, the effort to change ourselves and society in line with a consciousness-first view, and in 2018 he and his colleagues set up Quantum Activism Vishwalayam, which runs online and residential master's and doctoral programmes with a university in Jaipur. He also teaches online courses on quantum activism and the archetypes, many of them in English and Portuguese with partners in Brazil.

books.title: The Self-Aware Universe: How Consciousness Creates the Material World
books.author: Amit Goswami
books.description: His best-known book, which reads the paradoxes of quantum physics as pointing to consciousness as the basis of the world, drawing on Vedanta and other mystical traditions.

books.title: Physics of the Soul
books.author: Amit Goswami
books.description: A physicist's attempt to give a scientific account of the soul, survival after death and rebirth, framed within his consciousness-first reading of quantum theory.

books.title: God Is Not Dead: What Quantum Physics Tells Us about Our Origins and How We Should Live
books.author: Amit Goswami
books.description: An argument that a conscious, creative principle is compatible with modern physics, and a look at what that might mean for how people choose to live.

books.title: Quantum Creativity
books.author: Amit Goswami
books.description: His account of the creative process, with sudden insight treated as a quantum leap, and suggestions for cultivating creativity in daily life.

books.title: The Everything Answer Book
books.author: Amit Goswami
books.description: A question-and-answer introduction to his quantum worldview, covering consciousness, God, psychology and the meaning of life in short sections.

books.title: Quantum Spirituality
books.author: Amit Goswami, Valentina Onisor
books.description: Written with Valentina Onisor, a practical book on spiritual growth as seen through quantum science, aimed at living with more wholeness.

books.title: The Visionary Window: A Quantum Physicist's Guide to Enlightenment
books.author: Amit Goswami
books.description: A look at enlightenment and the world's wisdom traditions from the standpoint of a physicist who sees consciousness as primary.

books.title: How Quantum Activism Can Save Civilization
books.author: Amit Goswami
books.description: His short call to quantum activism: changing personal habits and social institutions in line with a consciousness-first view of the world.

books.title: The Return of the Archetypes
books.author: Amit Goswami
books.description: A study of archetypal values such as truth, love and beauty, and how giving them a place again could reshape personal and social life.

courses.title: Quantum Activism online course (Curso Online de Ativismo Quântico)
courses.description: An online course taught by Amit with Quantum Academy in Brazil, dubbed or subtitled in Portuguese, on bringing science and spirituality together in everyday choices and purpose.

courses.title: The Power of the Archetypes (O Poder dos Arquétipos)
courses.description: Ten video lessons from Amit on the archetypes and how they shape creativity and purpose, with two guided meditations and practical exercises, offered through Quantum Academy in Portuguese translation.
